payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintains sorted active orders via AVL tree; uses two boundaries (min/max of buy/sell segment) to greedily count possible direction assignments as ADDs and ACCEPTs are processed.
payload.rationale: Solution code features an AVL tree to store orders sorted, enabling O(log n) insertion/deletion and retrieval of extremes, which supports a two-pointer-like approach to maintain a valid buy/sell split. The greedy counting matches known two-pointer solutions.
